messages:
Rhea: Starting staged rollout v2026-06-07. Canary 5% -> us-west-2, then 10% global after quiet. Watching embeddings drift and latency.
Omar: Watching. QA will surface any semantic regressions in embedding recall sets. Call stop if embeddings drift > 4% or p95 > 2x.
ops-bot: ALERT: us-west-2 canary embedding-sim regression detected at T+7m. similarity-drop: baseline->canary = 5.8%
Lina: Thats above threshold. Errors and latency look fine but quality regression is real.
Rhea: We don't want to lose telemetry from a full rollback. Proposal: regional pin rollback for us-west-2 to v2026-05-30, keep canary elsewhere and continue EU ramp. Opinions?
Omar: Agree. Partial rollback by region seems best. We keep collecting EU/asia signals.
qa-bot: QA: embedding regression confirmed on testset A and B for us-west-2.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: action request: regional-rollback --region us-west-2 --from v2026-06-07 --to v2026-05-30 --until 5897690000 --reason "embedding-drift-detected"
deploy-bot: status: regional-rollback job rb-2001 started
ops-bot: INFO: rb-2001 progress: 2/2 control-plane switches queued
Lina: Rolling back region-only now. Will annotate release notes and change window.
Rhea: Add note: "Partial rollback in us-west-2 due to embedding similarity regression; region pinned to previous build while other regions continue ramp." Also add follow-up: run embedding evals across whole model fleet and compare.
Omar: Opened INC-7803 to investigate model index versioning mismatch in us-west-2 storage cache.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rb-2001 completed at 5897654405: us-west-2 pinned to v2026-05-30
ops-bot: NOTE: us-west-2 traffic now on v2026-05-30; global canary remains at 5% in other regions until 5897690200 per extended window.
Rhea: We'll hold global ramp for 30m while QA runs cross-region evals. If embeddings stabilize, proceed with gradual percent increase. If any other region shows >4% drift, we stop and consider full rollback.
Lina: Monitoring dashboards and eval outputs. Will post results in 15m.
qa-bot: QA: cross-region evals in progress.
Omar: Thanks team. Good tradeoff to preserve telemetry while protecting users in impacted region. Closing thread once INC-7803 has triage update.
